title: Misión de Marta: Alegia y Las cuerdas
description: docs/quests/marta.md. The mission part by part from the picker (just dev-mission marta <part>): Alegia and the piano, Las cuerdas' way, its mazes, a quality waiting, the pegs and the centre. Run it with --gpu.

steps.caption: Alegia: Marta beside the upright piano under the pergola (provisional place, stand-in figure)
Before the piano: Aitor's seat, Marta beside it
Just in: the way of dark glass over the void, the bubble behind, every string rising north
From further back: the first maze ahead, its pieces lit by note
Before the first maze, Aitor says what the floor does

steps.eval: (() => { const c = window.gerard.game.world(21, 101); window.gerard.game.frame({ x: c.x, y: 0, z: c.z }, 16); window.gerard.game.cuerdas.t = 12.11 - .05; window.gerard.game.setPaused(true); })()

steps.caption: Dos notas as she goes from La to Fa: amber and silver are there a moment, the time to step across
Mid-La: only the amber pieces and the knots hold

steps.eval: (() => { window.gerard.game.frame(); const s = window.gerard.game.cuerdas; s.fall = { since: .32, maze: 0 }; s.sink = (.32 - .16) ** 2 * 18; })()

steps.caption: A fall: teetering where the floor went, arms thrown up

steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.gerard.game.cuerdas; s.fall = { since: .62, maze: 0 }; s.sink = (.62 - .16) ** 2 * 18; })()
(() => { const s = window.gerard.game.cuerdas; s.fall = undefined; s.land = .26; s.sink = -3.2 * (1 - (.26 / .42) ** 2); })()

steps.caption: Back before the maze, dropping onto the landing, arms out

steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.gerard.game.cuerdas; s.land = undefined; s.sink = 0; window.gerard.game.setPaused(false); })()

steps.caption: La Lealtad and her Eco waiting on their platform

steps.eval: (() => { const r = window.gerard.game; const c = r.world(21, 72); r.frame({ x: c.x, y: 0, z: c.z }, 13); })()

steps.caption: Una pasada: cracked pieces, the switch on the right, and over the far gap only the bridge's frame
Up the right and onto the switch: its string lights and the bridge comes up over the gap
The third maze: the tuning pegs beside their rows, their walkway closed by a wall at the far end
Up the pegs' walkway: a wall of dark glass ends it short of the platform beyond, so the rows are the only way across
The centre, where every string meets: La Voz waiting
La Voz beaten: back in Alegia, the song as it should sound
Mission done: Marta, herself again, by the piano
